title: Mourning Customs
summary: Mourning customs could include weeping, lament, fasting, torn garments, sackcloth, ashes, professional mourners, and public expressions of grief.
background: These customs help modern readers understand why grief in Scripture is often visible, communal, and embodied.
teachingHelp: When teaching mourning scenes, allow the weight of grief to be felt while pointing to the hope and comfort God gives.
